title: TAVI — what "Save draft" does (agent fedelav803, ticket #518, build index-7qe5X0Gd.js)
lines: Click "Save draft" after typing "QA RPL EV draft text."
Network: no request to /desk/tickets/{id}/drafts (nothing sent to the server)
GET /desk/tickets/{id}/drafts/mine  → 404 "You have no draft on this ticket."
localStorage: desk.composer.draft:<agent id>:<ticket id> holds the text   ← only this browser
The server API for drafts exists (PUT drafts/mine 200, used by Send for review), so the draft could be stored there.
